title: Installation Jobs: CareLine Member Parts Discount on Trim Capping
content:
**CareLine member parts discount on trim capping — Installation Jobs**

A customer holding an active plan of **CareLine Service Plans** gets that plan's parts discount on exterior trim capping priced on an **Installation Jobs** record. The plan read is the customer's CareLine plan whose status is active.

| Customer's service holding | Rate on the capping |
|---|---|
| an active CareLine Estate Plan | that plan's parts discount |
| an active CareLine Premier Plan or CareLine Premier 3-Year Plan | that plan's parts discount |
| an active CareLine Plus Plan | that plan's parts discount |
| an active CareLine Basic Plan | that plan's parts discount |
| no active CareLine plan, or only an On-Call Service Account | nothing |

Each plan's parts discount is the parts discount that plan sets. The CareLine parts discount forms part of the capping discount rate.

## Cases (hypothetical holdings)

- A customer with an active CareLine Plus Plan whose parts discount is 10 percent takes 10 percent on the capping.
- A customer whose CareLine Premier Plan is no longer active, and who holds no other active plan, takes nothing.
- A customer with only an On-Call Service Account takes nothing.
